These are applications have been filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, by the accused in Crime Nos.162, 234, 261, 336, 271, 278, 907, 596 and 1734 of 2023 of Thiruvalla Police Station, Pathanamthitta, seeking anticipatory bail, for the second time.

In these matters, the prosecution alleges commission of offences punishable under Sections 406, 409, 420 read with 34 of Indian Penal Code as well as under Sections 3 read with 21(1), (2), (3),
5 read with 23 and 25(1) of the Banning of Unregulated Deposit Schemes Act, 2019.

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioners argued at length to convince this Court to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners for the second time.

Since he failed in this endeavour and when this Court is about to dismiss these petitions, holding that there is no change of circumstances 2024:KER:77866 B.A. Nos. 8307 of 2024 & Conn. Cases subsist, to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners, in negation to the earlier order of dismissal, the learned counsel for the petitioners sought permission to withdraw these petitions.
Permission granted.
Accordingly, these bail applications stand dismissed as withdrawn.

Sd/-
